treaty_name: Agreement between the Republic of Croatia and the Federal Republic of Germany for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2006)
eif_quote: OBJAVLJUJE da je Ugovor između Republike Hrvatske i Savezne Republike Njemačke o izbjegavanju dvostrukog oporezivanja porezima na dohodak i na imovinu, potpisan u Berlinu 6. veljače 2006., objavljen u »Narodnim novinama – Međunarodni ugovori« br. 9/2006, stupio na snagu 20. prosinca 2006.
source_title: Zakon o potvrđivanju Ugovora između RH i Savezne Republike Njemačke o izbjegavanju dvostrukog oporezivanja (NN-MU 9/2006)

rates.quote: ... ali ako je stvarni korisnik dividendi rezident druge države ugovornice, tada porez ne smije biti veći od: a) 5% od bruto-iznosa dividendi ako je stvarni korisnik društvo (ali ne društvo osoba) koje izravno posjeduje najmanje 10% kapitala društva koje isplaćuje dividende;
b) 15% od bruto-iznosa dividendi u svim ostalim slučajevima.
Kamate nastale u državi ugovornici, a isplaćene rezidentu druge države ugovornice, mogu se oporezivati samo u toj drugoj državi ugovornici, ako je ta osoba stvarni korisnik.
Autorske naknade nastale u državi ugovornici i isplaćene rezidentu druge države ugovornice mogu se oporezivati samo u drugoj državi, ako je ta osoba stvarni korisnik.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Art. 30(2)(a): WHT on amounts paid on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2006) -> 2007-01-01. Protocol para 3 (ad Arts. 10 and 11): dividends and interest from profit-participating rights/claims (silent partnership, participating loans, profit-sharing bonds) that are deductible for the payer may be taxed under source-State law without treaty limit (not modelled). Protocol para 2: renegotiation clause for Art. 11 if a State introduces/extends taxation of interest paid to non-residents.
